---
title: "Digital Rodent BLR Model"
format: gfm
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

from pcntoolkit import (
    BLR,
    NormativeModel,
    NormData,
    plot_qq
)

import pcntoolkit.util.output


# ============================================================
# SETUP
# ============================================================

current_dir = Path.cwd().parent

model_df = pd.read_csv(
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "combined_dataset"
    / "Model_dataframe.csv"
)

model_dir = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "normative_model"
    / "BLR"
)

model_dir.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)

pcntoolkit.util.output.Output.set_show_messages(False)


# ============================================================
# DEFINE MODEL VARIABLES
# ============================================================

response_vars = [
    f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)
]

batch_effects = [
    "Dataset_name"
]

covariates = [
    col for col in model_df.columns
    if col not in (
        [
            "Scan_id",
            "Participant_Id",
            "Dataset_name"
        ]
        + response_vars
    )
]


print("Rows:", len(model_df))
print("Covariates:", len(covariates))
print(covariates)
print("Batch effects:", batch_effects)
print("Responses:", response_vars)


# ============================================================
# CHECK DATA
# ============================================================

print(
    "Missing covariate values:",
    model_df[covariates].isna().sum().sum()
)

print(
    "Missing response values:",
    model_df[response_vars].isna().sum().sum()
)


# ============================================================
# CREATE NORMDATA
# ============================================================

norm_data = NormData.from_dataframe(
    name="DigitalRodent",
    dataframe=model_df,
    covariates=covariates,
    batch_effects=batch_effects,
    response_vars=response_vars,
    remove_Nan=False
)


# ============================================================
# TRAIN / TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================

train, test = norm_data.train_test_split()


# ============================================================
# BLR MODEL
# ============================================================

model = NormativeModel(
    BLR(
        heteroskedastic=True
    ),
    inscaler="standardize",
    outscaler="standardize",
    savemodel=True,
    evaluate_model=True,
    saveresults=True,
    saveplots=True,
    save_dir=str(model_dir)
)


# ============================================================
# FIT MODEL
# ============================================================

model.fit_predict(
    train,
    test
)


# ============================================================
# QQ PLOTS
# ============================================================

qq_dir = (
    model_dir
    / "plots"
    / "qq"
)

qq_dir.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)

plot_qq(
    test,
    plot_id_line=True,
    save_dir=str(qq_dir)
)


# ============================================================
# RESULTS
# ============================================================

train_stats = train.get_statistics_df()
test_stats = test.get_statistics_df()

print("\nTrain statistics:")
display(train_stats)

print("\nTest statistics:")
display(test_stats)

train_stats.to_csv(
    model_dir / "Train_statistics.csv",
    index=False
)

test_stats.to_csv(
    model_dir / "Test_statistics.csv",
    index=False
)

print("\nBLR training finished.")
print("Saved to:")
print(model_dir)
```
